label: HB dissociation 1ns, guidance recovery vs short-MD covered length with 6 history statistics (experiment-D definition), strong base (K75)

length_definition.unit: covered length (ns), same definition as L01/L02; prefix = frames 0..(L/0.1) of the 0-1 ns history, 100 ps spacing
length_definition.note: Differs from the G-series naming at 1.0 ns: the G-series '1.0 ns' prefix is frames [0..9], while L01/L02's covered 1.0 ns is frames [0..10] (the full-history mean).

statistics6_definition.source: MolCasta-InternalResearch branch research/fixed-1ns-3phen-6h-20261121, GPT playground/ATLAS-observed-2026-11-19/fixed_1ns_history_3phen_6h.py, features_from_history(series, bound); same definition as L39/L40
statistics6_definition.threshold_source: THRESH['hb'] = 3.5 in the same script (HB boundary)
statistics6_definition.application_to_prefix: the same formula applied to the prefix sub-series frames 0..k; 'last' is the last frame of the prefix and the fraction is taken within the prefix
statistics6_definition.relation_to_k75_history10: K75's 10 history features are [first, mean, std, min, max, last-first, last-prev, frac<=3.5A, frac<=4.5A, frac increasing], stored in the K2-18 bundle and recomputed from the stored series for all calibration+test candidates (see history_stats_check). The experiment-D 6 statistics are the subset at positions [0,1,2,3,5,7]; the 10 are the 6 plus [max, last-prev, frac<=4.5A, frac increasing]. Full history (10 stats on all 11 frames) is therefore a superset of the covered-1.0 ns 6-stats condition.

base.name: K75 strong base for HB dissociation: HistGBM correction model (160 iters, lr 0.065, 15 leaves, min_samples_leaf 20, L2 0.15, seed 20261121), trained on calibration proteins, evaluated on 100 unseen proteins x 3 replicas (input bundle from K2-18)

bootstrap.resampling_unit: protein (100 test proteins, resampled with replacement)
bootstrap.note: Within each resample, static-only, full-history and each prefix condition's AUPRCs are recomputed and the gain and recovery are recomputed inside the sample. Models are not refit; per-candidate predicted probabilities are resampled. Both families (mean-only and 6-stats) are bootstrapped from the same draws. Pooled AUPRC uses a numpy implementation of sklearn's average_precision_score (threshold-grouped), verified against sklearn to <1e-9 on the full test set for every condition. Macro AUPRC within a resample is the multiplicity-weighted mean of per-protein AUPRCs over proteins whose AUPRC is defined.
